headline: Catch materials compliance problems the week they appear
capabilities: Scans approved bills of materials and reports what changed
Flags newly non-compliant items with the cited evidence
Finds same-spec compliant alternates and sizes the switch
Keeps certificates and audit evidence current and drafts approved next steps
outcomes: Catches compliance problems before materials are ordered
Ties every finding to its evidence
why_try: The demo runs a full weekly compliance cycle in six plain questions, from what changed to approved drafts, and every finding names the record behind it.

sample_prompts.label: Procurement Compliance Lead: Weekly BOM change scan
sample_prompts.prompt: What changed on our approved bills of materials this week?

sample_prompts.label: Procurement Compliance Lead: Materials compliance check
sample_prompts.prompt: Is anything newly out of compliance, and why?

sample_prompts.label: Buyer: Compliant alternates
sample_prompts.prompt: Find me a compliant replacement for the gate valve with the same spec.

sample_prompts.label: Supplier Quality Manager: Vendor certificate watch
sample_prompts.prompt: Which vendor certificates have lapsed or are about to?

sample_prompts.label: Program Compliance Reviewer: Audit evidence readiness
sample_prompts.prompt: Are we ready if the program auditor asks for our evidence package?

sample_prompts.label: Procurement Compliance Lead: Approved next-step drafts
sample_prompts.prompt: I approve the hold, the GV-08B substitution and the vendor follow-ups. Prepare the drafts.
